moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio cam-zoomvsdolly, written here): Lens zoom: every layer scales by the same factor about the frame centre, 1 -> 1.2 over 1600 ms easeInOutCubic, so depth flattens (compare with the push-in). Demo: 1 -> 1.3 over 2.3 s ease-in-out. Params: duration (1.6 s) · scale (1 → 1.2) · ease (power2.inOut).
